title: Rain on the Roof
passage_text:
Pitter, patter, rain on the roof.
Pitter, patter, puddles grow.
Big brown boots go splish and splash.
Rain, rain, where did you go?

Soft gray clouds slide slowly by.
Sun peeks out to say hello.
Pitter, patter, rain on the roof.
Rain, rain, where did you go?

My mom and I make muddy pies.
We watch the worms wiggle below.
Pitter, patter, the rain is done.
Tomorrow, rain, come back slow!

skill_instances.quote: Pitter, patter, rain on the roof.
skill_instances.explanation: This line repeats in the poem.

skill_instances.quote: Rain, rain, where did you go?
skill_instances.explanation: This question repeats at the end of two stanzas.
Alliteration: big and brown start with the same sound.
Alliteration: slide and slowly both start with s.
Alliteration: watch, worms and wiggle start with w.

protagonist.notes: child speaker playing with mom after rain

setting: a home porch and yard on a rainy day

lesson_hooks.i_do: Model the repeated line 'Pitter, patter, rain on the roof.'
lesson_hooks.we_do: Find two words that start with the same sound in stanza two.
lesson_hooks.you_do_question: Which line repeats in the poem?
